message:
Qoid has built three featured projects:

1. Facial Expression Recognition System (2024) — an AI/ML project using VGG16 and SE-Block Attention, built with Python, TensorFlow, Keras, and OpenCV. It achieved 66.9% accuracy on the FER-2013 dataset, a +15.2% improvement over baseline, and is deployed for real-time inference on Hugging Face Spaces.

2. Agent Status (2026) — an AI agent observability platform built with TypeScript, Node.js, SQLite, and WebSocket. It provides local-first monitoring for AI coding agents with provider health metrics, token analytics, and error intelligence dashboards.

3. AUREX (2026) — an AI style intelligence web app that analyzes facial landmarks from selfies to give personalized style recommendations, using Laravel, Tailwind CSS, and a Python FastAPI microservice with MediaPipe.

Would you like more detail on any of these?
